meta.name: add-imessage
meta.description: Add iMessage to NanoClaw — one channel, two backends. Local (this Mac's chat.db via the Chat SDK bridge; macOS + Full Disk Access) or Hosted iMessage (via photon.codes — native spectrum-ts with a device-login wizard; any OS, no Mac relay). Triggers on "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon", "imessage via photon", "native imessage".

copy.tagline: 让 NanoClaw 连接 iMessage 通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在使用 NanoClaw 并希望接收 iMessage 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Connect iMessage to NanoClaw as a channel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use NanoClaw and want to receive iMessage messages.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会帮你在 NanoClaw 中安装并启用 iMessage 通道: 复制适配器、注册、安装依赖并验证;随后引导你选择本地(macOS 需授权完全磁盘访问)或 Photon 远程模式,配置环境变量并重启服务。
howto.when: 当用户要求把 iMessage 接到 NanoClaw,例如说 “add imessage”“connect imessage” 或 “add photon” 时触发。

say.text: 帮 NanoClaw 添加 iMessage 通道
say.note: 会先询问选本地还是 Photon 模式。

say.text: 用 Photon 远程模式连接 iMessage
say.note: 需要提供服务器 URL 和 API key。

say.text: 在这个 Mac 上启用本地 iMessage

howto.what_en: Claude can add an iMessage channel to NanoClaw: copy the adapter, register it, install the pinned dependency, validate with tests, then have you choose local (macOS, Full Disk Access) or Photon remote mode, configure .env and restart the service.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add iMessage to NanoClaw, e.g. saying "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon", etc.

say_en.text: Add an iMessage channel to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Asks you to pick local or Photon mode first.

say_en.text: Connect iMessage via Photon remote mode.
say_en.note: Needs the server URL and API key.

say_en.text: Enable local iMessage on this Mac.
